experience.summary: Building MCP tool-server simulations of 350+ third-party services for agent tool-use training, on a shared Pydantic validation and auto-populate framework with pytest scenario coverage.
Backend owner for an energy-sector operations platform: Python microservices on AWS Lambda, AppSync GraphQL, SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL, with CI/CD on AWS CDK.
Led backend delivery for the same energy platform (with Infosys as client) before joining Infosys directly: Python, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda and CDK.
Nine years building FinTech banking and payments APIs, a Python SDK, and productivity tools for activity analytics and task management.
Built PHP web applications with the CakePHP and CodeIgniter frameworks and WordPress CMS.

projects.title: MCP Service Simulation Suite
projects.summary: Near-exact simulations of 350+ third-party services delivered as MCP tool servers, so AI agents learn to call real APIs reliably.
projects.description: Each simulation replicates a real service's auth flows, endpoints and edge cases. A shared Pydantic validation and auto-populate framework keeps derived fields, referential integrity and tool schemas consistent across every simulated service. Agent workflows are orchestrated with LangChain and LangGraph, with RAG pipelines grounding agents in service documentation.
features: Stateful service simulations exposed as MCP tool servers
RAG retrieval over service docs and API specs
Realistic auth flows, endpoints and edge cases
Shared Pydantic validation and auto-populate framework
Referential integrity and consistent tool schemas
responsibilities: Build and harden simulations for email, design, messaging and terminal services
Own the shared validation framework
Author multi-turn coding tasks with regression tests
Review side-by-side agent trajectories

responsibilities: Own the backend: requirements, implementation plans and APIs
